summary: End-to-end test of Vision Studio. Backend: 7/9 pytest tests passed. Root, Chat (assistant + photo_edit with image), Projects full CRUD, Video job kickoff+status and 404 handling all work. Image generation and image editing endpoints FAIL with 500 because the Gemini model 'gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview' returns 404 NOT_FOUND from the Gemini API. Frontend: 100% of required data-testids and flows work — Home hero, all 6 bento cards, theme toggle (adds 'dark' class), navigation to /photo, /image-gen (with preset-0..4), /assistant chat send/receive in Bahasa Indonesia, and /projects empty state.

critical.issue: Returns 500. Underlying Gemini API responds 404: 'models/gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview is not found for API version v1beta, or is not supported for generateContent.' The Nano Banana model id in server.py .with_model('gemini','gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview') is not accepted by the current Emergent LLM proxy / Gemini v1beta. Image generation is completely broken.
Same root cause as /api/generate-image — uses gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview which returns 404 NOT_FOUND. Image editing is completely broken.

integration_issues.issue: These flows will fail at the backend layer because /api/edit-image and /api/generate-image return 500. UI itself renders correctly; failure only manifests when the user actually runs a generation.

action_items: Fix the Gemini image model identifier. 'gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview' is rejected by Gemini v1beta (404 NOT_FOUND). Update .with_model('gemini', ...) in generate_image and edit_image in /app/backend/server.py to a valid image-generation-capable model (e.g., verify via Emergent LLM proxy which Nano Banana model id is currently supported — likely 'gemini-2.5-flash-image' or the current Nano Banana slug). Confirm with a small text-to-image call after change.
After backend model fix, re-run image generation & editing tests, and manually test PhotoEdit + ImageGen flows end-to-end (auto-save project on success).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: image gen and edit share nearly identical LlmChat setup — consider a small helper _multimodal_image(model, system, prompt, images) to DRY.
server.py: 500 handler exposes raw upstream error via str(e) in HTTPException detail. OK for dev, but consider a cleaner user-facing message and structured logging.
server.py: Project.payload has no size cap — thumbnail_base64 and payload can grow large in Mongo docs (>16MB doc limit risk when video_base64 stored).
seed_data_creation: One project 'TEST_project_1' created and then deleted during CRUD test. No residual test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and are parallel-safe (pytest-xdist configured). All frontend data-testids in the review request are wired and working — no need to re-verify unless UI is changed. Priority next test after fix: /api/generate-image and /api/edit-image returning 200 with valid base64, then the two frontend flows PhotoEdit (photo-generate) and ImageGen (image-gen-run) that should auto-save a project.
rca_of_the_issue: The Gemini image-preview model slug 'gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview' used in server.py generate_image and edit_image is not exposed under the current Gemini v1beta / Emergent LLM proxy configuration. Server returns 500 with upstream body 'models/gemini-2.5-flash-image-preview is not found for API version v1beta, or is not supported for generateContent'. Chat endpoint works because it uses 'gemini-2.5-flash' which is available. Fix requires updating the model name to the currently supported Nano Banana / Gemini image model id.
